records.type:
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace E]
  [inst_3 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [inst_4 : NeZero (Module.finrank ℝ E)] {H : Type u_2} [inst_5 : TopologicalSpace H]
  {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H} [inst_6 : I.Boundaryless] {M : Type u_3} [inst_7 : TopologicalSpace M]
  [inst_8 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_9 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] [inst_10 : SigmaCompactSpace M] [inst_11 : T2Space M]
  {g : ℝ → Riemannian.RiemannianMetric I M} {J : Set ℝ},
  MorganTianLib.IsRicciFlowOn g J →
    ∀ (α : M) (U V W : E) {t : ℝ},
      t ∈ interior J →
        ∀ {y : E},
          y ∈ (extChartAt I α).target →
            have p := ↑(extChartAt I α).symm y;
            have R := (trivializationAt E (TangentSpace I) α).symm p;
            have A := deriv (fun s => MorganTianLib.chartChristoffelBilin (g s) α y) t;
            have hLC :=
              Riemannian.AffineConnection.isLeviCivita_of_koszulDual (g t) (g t).leviCivitaConnection fun X Y W q =>
                Riemannian.RiemannianMetric.koszulDualSection_dual (g t) X Y W q;
            (g t).metricInner p (R ((A U) V)) (R W) =
              -MorganTianLib.covRicciAt (g t) (g t).leviCivitaConnection hLC p (R U) (R V) (R W) -
                  MorganTianLib.covRicciAt (g t) (g t).leviCivitaConnection hLC p (R V) (R U) (R W) +
                MorganTianLib.covRicciAt (g t) (g t).leviCivitaConnection hLC p (R W) (R U) (R V)

  [inst_5 : I.Boundaryless] {M : Type u_3} [inst_6 : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_7 : ChartedSpace H M]
  [inst_8 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M] {g : ℝ → Riemannian.RiemannianMetric I M} {c : ℝ → ℝ → M} {J : Set ℝ},
  CurveControl.Geometry.IsCurveShorteningFlowOn g c J →
    ∀ [inst_9 : SigmaCompactSpace M] [inst_10 : T2Space M],
      MorganTianLib.IsRicciFlowOn g J →
        ∀ {t : ℝ},
          t ∈ interior J →
            ∀ (x : ℝ),
              have S := CurveControl.Geometry.unitTangent (g t) (c t) x;
              have N := CurveControl.Geometry.curvatureVector (g t) (c t) x;
              have P := CurveControl.Geometry.normalCurvatureGradient (g t) (c t) x;
              HasDerivAt (fun s => CurveControl.Geometry.curvatureSq (g s) (c s) x)
                (CurveControl.Analysis.arcDeriv (CurveControl.Geometry.curveSpeed (g t) (c t))
                        (CurveControl.Analysis.arcDeriv (CurveControl.Geometry.curveSpeed (g t) (c t))
                          (CurveControl.Geometry.curvatureSq (g t) (c t)))
                        x -
                      2 * (g t).metricInner (c t x) P P +
                    2 * CurveControl.Geometry.curvatureSq (g t) (c t) x ^ 2 +
                  (4 * CurveControl.Geometry.curvatureSq (g t) (c t) x *
                          ((MorganTianLib.ricciTensorAt (g t) (c t x)) S) S -
                        2 * ((MorganTianLib.ricciTensorAt (g t) (c t x)) N) N +
                      2 * CurveControl.Geometry.AmbientBounds.rm (g t) (c t x) N S N S +
                    (-4 * CurveControl.Geometry.AmbientBounds.covRic (g t) (c t x) S S N +
                      2 * CurveControl.Geometry.AmbientBounds.covRic (g t) (c t x) N S S)))
                t

Every metric-structure field is constructed, not supplied as an assumption.

records.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
  {K : Type u_2} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace K] {J : ModelWithCorners ℝ F K} {N : Type u_3} [inst_4 : TopologicalSpace N]
  [inst_5 : ChartedSpace K N] [inst_6 : IsManifold J (↑⊤) N] (h₀ : Riemannian.RiemannianMetric J N) (ℓ : { r // 0 < r })
  (p : N) (u v : TangentSpace J p),
  (CurveControl.Examples.StaticFactorApplication.scaledFactorMetric h₀ ℓ).metricInner p u v =
    ↑ℓ ^ 2 * h₀.metricInner p u v
records.docstring: **Math.** The constructed metric has the promised bilinear evaluation.

records.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
  {K : Type u_2} [inst_3 : TopologicalSpace K] {J : ModelWithCorners ℝ F K} {N : Type u_3} [inst_4 : TopologicalSpace N]
  [inst_5 : ChartedSpace K N] [inst_6 : IsManifold J (↑⊤) N] [NeZero (Module.finrank ℝ F)] [J.Boundaryless]
  [SigmaCompactSpace N] [T2Space N] {E : Type u_4} [inst_11 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_12 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [inst_13 : FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [inst_14 : NeZero (Module.finrank ℝ E)] {H : Type u_5}
  [inst_15 : TopologicalSpace H] {I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H} [inst_16 : I.Boundaryless] {M : Type u_6}
  [inst_17 : TopologicalSpace M] [inst_18 : ChartedSpace H M] [inst_19 : IsManifold I (↑⊤) M]
  [inst_20 : SigmaCompactSpace M] [inst_21 : T2Space M] [CompactSpace M] {g : ℝ → Riemannian.RiemannianMetric I M}
  {a b : ℝ},
  MorganTianLib.IsRicciFlowOn g (Set.Icc a b) →
    a ≤ b →
      Module.finrank ℝ F = 1 →
        ∃ B C,
          0 ≤ B ∧
            0 ≤ C ∧
              ∀ (h₀ : Riemannian.RiemannianMetric J N) (ι : Type u_7) (c : { r // 0 < r } → ι → ℝ → ℝ → M × N),
                (∀ (ℓ : { r // 0 < r }) (i : ι),
                    CurveControl.Geometry.IsCurveShorteningFlowOn
                      (fun t =>
                        CurveControl.Geometry.productL2Metric I J (g t)
                          (CurveControl.Examples.StaticFactorApplication.scaledFactorMetric h₀ ℓ))
                      (c ℓ i) (Set.Icc a b)) →
                  ∀ (L₀ Θ₀ : ℝ),
                    (∀ (ℓ : { r // 0 < r }) (i : ι),
                        CurveControl.Geometry.curveLength
                            (CurveControl.Geometry.productL2Metric I J (g a)
                              (CurveControl.Examples.StaticFactorApplication.scaledFactorMetric h₀ ℓ))
                            (c ℓ i a) ≤
                          L₀) →
                      (∀ (ℓ : { r // 0 < r }) (i : ι),
                          CurveControl.Geometry.totalCurvature
                              (CurveControl.Geometry.productL2Metric I J (g a)
                                (CurveControl.Examples.StaticFactorApplication.scaledFactorMetric h₀ ℓ))
                              (c ℓ i a) ≤
                            Θ₀) →
                        ∀ (ℓ : { r // 0 < r }) (i : ι),
                          ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b,
                            CurveControl.Geometry.curveLength
                                  (CurveControl.Geometry.productL2Metric I J (g t)
                                    (CurveControl.Examples.StaticFactorApplication.scaledFactorMetric h₀ ℓ))
                                  (c ℓ i t) ≤
                                L₀ * Real.exp (B * (t - a)) ∧
                              CurveControl.Geometry.totalCurvature
                                  (CurveControl.Geometry.productL2Metric I J (g t)
                                    (CurveControl.Examples.StaticFactorApplication.scaledFactorMetric h₀ ℓ))
                                  (c ℓ i t) ≤
                                (Θ₀ + L₀) * Real.exp (C * (t - a))

**Math.** Concrete scaled-metric application. Exponential constants are
chosen from the compact base flow before h₀, the positive scale, curve indices
or initial bounds. Smooth immersed closed product-flow existence and the two
common initial bounds are the caller's only curve inputs.

**Math.** A downstream full-interval bound suitable for a later ramp
argument: one finite length bound and one finite total-curvature bound hold
simultaneously for all t, all curves and every positive scale, even as λ→0.
This is an estimate only; it does not assert ramp or curve-flow existence.
